scientific_integrity: Uses the established colored-tree correspondence explicitly credited to Gubarev; exact matrix identity and finite-field cases independently checked; no claim of independent review.
scientific_limitations: Fixed nonzero weight; all distinct operators, not conjugacy classes. Rank convergence is in L2; no central limit theorem or optimal error bound. Full independent source-priority audit has not been carried out.
title: A rank polynomial and concentration law for Rota–Baxter operators on finite sums of fields
